tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
OTECH OTE-BS12D55W Wireless Bluetooth 1D/2D/QR Barcode Scanner

The OTECH OTE-BS12D55W is a high-performance wireless barcode scanner designed to efficiently scan 1D, 2D, and QR codes with precision and speed. Featuring Bluetooth connectivity, this scanner provides seamless data transmission to a variety of devices, including PCs, tablets, and smartphones. Its long battery life, durable design, and multi-code compatibility make it an ideal solution for retail, logistics, healthcare, and inventory management applications.

Features of OTECH Wireless Bluetooth 1D/2D/QR Barcode Scanner

  • 1D & 2D Barcode Scanning: Easily scans 1D, 2D, and QR codes, including printed and digital formats.
  • Wireless Bluetooth Connectivity: Connects to devices via Bluetooth, offering freedom of movement up to 30 meters.
  • High-Speed Scanning: Ensures quick and accurate barcode reading, reducing processing time.
  • Multiple Connectivity Options: Supports Bluetooth, 2.4G wireless, and USB wired connection for versatile usage.
  • Long Battery Life: Provides extended scanning operation on a single charge, ideal for all-day use.
  • Durable & Ergonomic Design: Built to withstand drops and impacts, ensuring longevity in high-usage environments.
  • Plug-and-Play Setup: No need for complex installations—simply connect and start scanning.
  • Smart Auto-Sensing Mode: Supports hands-free auto-detection for faster scanning efficiency.
  • Wide Compatibility: Works with Windows, Mac, Android, and iOS devices, supporting multiple business applications.
  • Ideal for Various Industries: Perfect for retail, warehouse management, healthcare, logistics, and supermarkets.
